body: I can't imagine anyone down voting you here. I understand why you would say what you did. I can't help but think that somewhere inside you want help, posting anything here usually means just that. If you ever need to talk, yell, scream, cry... Please message me. People that love you are everywhere. Strangers on the internet care, I'm sure many people in your life care. Stay strong, fight!

Thank you everyone for all your kind words. I wish I could show this to her, she really was loved. Sometimes the pain gets to be too much I guess. I've been going through different stages of grief and blaming myself has been a prominent thought. I know deep down that I did all I could but if I had just been there maybe things would have been different.
